'''Donald Snider First Rebellion (Fun)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Donald Snider]]
* '''Published:''' May 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Local Uprising / Liberation|Local Uprising]]
* '''Strategy:''' First Rebellion (Fun)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE First Rebellion (Fun) Snider LS 1999.txt |Download]]
